resources.string: Answers to the most common questions
Send us a ticket and a real person will reply here in the app, usually within 2 business days.
If something isn’t working, contact support from Help & Support.

Include what you did, what you expected and what happened. For orders, include the player ID.

Waiting for support · we usually reply within 2 business days

Play games and answer quizzes to earn XP. XP levels you up, and every new level gives you Stars to claim on the Level rewards screen. You also earn Stars from weekly tournament prizes, referrals and partner offers on the Earn tab.
What is the difference between XP and Stars?
XP measures your progress and decides your level and tournament rank. Stars are your reward balance, and Stars are what you redeem for in-game currency. XP is never spent.
Why can’t I play more games or quizzes today?
Games and quizzes each have a daily limit. You can unlock a few extra attempts by watching a short ad. Everything resets at 00:00 UTC.
I watched an ad but didn’t get my reward

A reward only counts if the ad plays to the end. Closing it early gives nothing, but the offer stays so you can try again. If there is no ad available, wait a minute and retry. Using an ad blocker, VPN or private DNS stops ads from loading.

The offer partner decides whether an offer was completed, and some take up to 24 hours to confirm. We credit Stars as soon as they do. If it still hasn’t arrived, contact the partner’s support from inside their offer wall, because only they can review it.
How do I redeem my Stars?
Open the Wallet tab, choose a game and a pack, then enter your player ID, username and server exactly as they appear in the game. The Stars are taken when you place the order.
How long does a redemption take?
Every order is checked by a person. Most are delivered within 48 hours, and all within 7 business days. You can follow each order on the Orders tab in Wallet.
I entered the wrong player ID

Open a support ticket straight away while the order is still pending, and link the order. We will try to stop it. Once currency has been delivered to a player ID it can’t be recovered, so always double-check before confirming.

Usually because the player ID or server couldn’t be found, or the order failed our fraud checks. If the details were wrong, your Stars are returned to your balance. Orders declined for cheating don’t get Stars back.
Your first pack for a game account can cost fewer Stars. It can be used once per game account, even across different PixelPayout accounts.
Each new level unlocks a Stars reward. Open Level rewards from Home and tap Claim. If you have several waiting, they are claimed one at a time, starting from the lowest level.
How does the weekly tournament work?

It’s free and opens once you reach level 10. XP you earn from games and quizzes during the week (Monday to Sunday, UTC) decides your rank. The top places win Stars, paid after the week ends. The full prize table is on the Earn tab.
Share your code from Profile. Your friend enters it before reaching level 10. You earn 50 ★ when they reach level 10, and 150 ★ more when they make their first full-price redemption.
I forgot to enter a referral code
You can still enter one in Profile under “Have a code?”, as long as you haven’t reached level 10 yet.
Can I have more than one account?
No. Each person and each device may have one account. Extra accounts are banned and lose all their Stars.
Can I use a VPN, emulator or auto-clicker?
No. VPNs, proxies, emulators, rooted phones, modified apps and auto-clickers are not allowed, and accounts using them are banned.
My account was banned. What can I do?
If you believe it was a mistake, open a support ticket (or email us from the address on your account) within 30 days, and we will review it.
How do I delete my account?
Go to Profile → Account → Delete account. Deleting is permanent and removes your Stars, so redeem first. You can’t delete while a redemption is pending.
